headline: General Motors Initiates Search for Successor to Longtime CEO Mary Barra
summary: General Motors has begun a search for a successor to Chair and Chief Executive Officer Mary Barra, who has led the Detroit automaker since 2014, according to Wall Street Journal reports.
why: Mary Barra has steered GM through major restructuring, EV development, and its recent stock listing shift, making CEO succession critical for strategic direction.

impacts.name: General Motors Company
impacts.why: Executive succession planning at GM introduces leadership transition dynamics for investors.
